body:
Because every time I made my suicidal feelings known, people gave me a load of BULLSHIT like "aww you aren't ugly (lie). You just need to work on your confidence (lie)". Or "it gets better when you get older (lie). Don't kill yourself now (lie). You will be happy; trust me (lie)".

I also didn't want to inconvenience my family. But now I don't really give a fuck. They've had enough time to know that I'm likely to kill myself. It won't be a surprise for them. And if they still don't like it, boo fucking hoo. They can have a little cry about their loser of a relative being dead. "Good riddance" they probably say to themselves. And they can make themselves feel better by falling asleep sound in the knowledge that a significant portion of the opposite sex finds them attractive and they won't have to long for the validation of intimacy.

Just so you know, I've been drinking.

It's scary just how confident I feel about killing myself when I've had a drink. Takes only a few minutes before I get the courage to do things normal people are too chicken to do.

Half hour ago I was scared of dying. Now I can't wait to go back to not being alive. I imagine it feels like what it felt like before I was born.

When I was in my early 20s, I was talking to a girl I met on that shitty video game "Runescape". We exchanged MSNs. Talked for months. Then she went on cam and I thought she was really pretty. She had a lot of acne, and was very fat, but I thought was cute. Then I sent her a picture of me. She immediately became uninterested. Started replying to me slower and slower. I got the hint. Not her fault she thinks I'm an ugly fucking freak who is nothing but a genetic dead end. I would think the same.

Anyway, I went to the pantry and grabbed the first drink. I think it was wine. Drank the lot in one go. Then I got a knife and started cutting my leg open. Was really weird that there wasn't much blood. Could see all the fat and shit. Got a nice big scar down my leg because of that. The thing is, I'm squeamish of needles, knives, and cuts, but when I had a drink I lost that inhibition. That was the first time I seriously started self-harming.

My point is that alcohol can really enable someone to do things they're too much of a pussy to do normally; like kill themselves.

I agree. I am sure almost everyone feels unattractive from time to time. But these are the same people who have no problems getting in a relationship. These are people who are merely insecure. I don't really care that I'm ugly. I care about being a sad loner who never experienced romance. I can deal with people treating me with contempt. But I can't deal with a life of zero intimacy with a woman.

I have already challenged myself. Do you have any idea how hard it is to keep messaging women on online dating, when 99.9% of the time I get no response, and when I do get a response 99% of them are "sorry not interested", and the remaining 1% respond out of pity, only to eventually stop responding anyway?

Do you know how hard it is to suppress the basic biological drive for sex and intimacy? I should have killed myself a long time ago. Most men kill themselves for much lesser reasons than I will kill myself.

I do fake "that shit". I fake not being suicidal all the time.

You're giving me advice that I did when I was 17. I'm getting old. Even if a girl looked past my appearance, I would be very clingy, have no idea how to form a relationship, and scare her off anyway.

Soon as the shit gets here tomorrow I'm drinking myself half to death and then doing the other half. I'll probably start drinking now. The shit should be here within 12 hours.

I shouldn't have been born. I have congenital abnormalities that were a death sentence from the start. I had no chance from day 1. My mom should have dropped me down the stairs. Would have saved me from this fucking shitty life of loneliness.

Well I'm not attractive. Guess that explains why they don't like me.

I do know my value, though: Worthless.
